rfp.body:
Hello,

We are looking for a quiet, discreet venue for a board meeting.

Arrival: 2027-04-08, 1 night (departure 2027-04-09)
Guests: 12, single-occupancy rooms (12 room nights)
Meeting space: one boardroom for 12 for the day, with lunch and coffee. No breakout rooms needed.
Dietary needs: none reported.
Accessibility: no wheelchair users (0).
Preference: harbour view if possible.
Budget: up to EUR 8,000 in total.

Please send availability, a full price breakdown and your terms by 2026-10-25.

Thank you.
